name: read_card
description: Read the current character card: every field in FULL (name, description, appearance, personality, backstory, scenario, first_message, example_dialogue, creator_notes, system_prompt, post_history_instructions, tags, world), plus every alternate greeting and lorebook entry with its index. If the card is too long to show whole, the longest texts are SHORTENED and marked with the read_field call that returns them whole - set_field / edit_greeting / edit_lorebook_entry REPLACE the entire text, so read the full text first.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build. Pass it on every call.

name: read_field
description: Read ONE card text in full, verbatim: a field (description, appearance, personality, backstory, scenario, first_message, example_dialogue, creator_notes, system_prompt, post_history_instructions, name, world), an alternate greeting (field: "greeting" + index) or a lorebook entry (field: "lorebook" + index). Use it before editing a long text so the edit keeps everything you did not mean to change.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build. Pass it on every call.

name: set_field
description: Set a top-level card field. field must be one of: name, description, personality, scenario, first_message, example_dialogue, creator_notes, system_prompt, post_history_instructions.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

field.description: Field name (name, description, personality, scenario, first_message, example_dialogue, creator_notes, system_prompt, post_history_instructions).

value.description: The full text to set for this field.

name: set_extension
description: Set an extension field: backstory, appearance, or world (the character's world/pool). Fill backstory + appearance + a rich description so the GM and World Builder can use them.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

name: set_tags
description: Replace the card's tags with 3-8 short lowercase tags.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

name: add_greeting
description: Add an alternate opening line (greeting) for the character.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

name: add_lorebook_entry
description: Add an entry to the character's OWN lorebook: keyword-triggered facts the GM injects when relevant (places, factions, items, relationships, or secrets tied to this character).

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

content.description: The fact/lore text injected when a key matches.

name.description: Optional short name for the entry.

name: edit_lorebook_entry
description: Edit an existing lorebook entry by its index (from read_card).

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

index.description: 0-based index of the entry to edit.

name: delete_lorebook_entry
description: Delete a lorebook entry by its 0-based index.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

index.description: 0-based index of the entry to delete.

name: set_group
description: Assign the character to a named group/folder (only when the user asks).

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

name: list_source_cards
description: BULK MODE: list every source card in the input group with its number, name, and status (done/current/pending).

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

name: load_source_card
description: BULK MODE: pull a chosen source card (by number, name, or id) in as the current source to reimagine next. Blanks the workspace for a fresh character.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

card.description: The source card's number, name, or id.

name: mark_source_done
description: BULK MODE: manually check a source card off as done (by number, name, or id). Does not create or save a character.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

card.description: The source card's number, name, or id.

name: mark_source_pending
description: BULK MODE: put a source card back in the queue (undo a done mark), by number, name, or id.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

card.description: The source card's number, name, or id.

name: list_output_cards
description: BULK MODE: list the characters you've already created in the output group (to revisit one).

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

name: load_output_card
description: BULK MODE: load a saved output character (by number, name, or id) onto the workspace to EDIT it. Your edits update that existing character; call finish_editing or finalize_character when done. Do NOT create a duplicate.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

card.description: The output character's number, name, or id.

name: finish_editing
description: BULK MODE: stop editing a loaded output character and return to building new ones (blanks the workspace).

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

name: list_drafts
description: BULK MODE: list unfinished DRAFTS (started but not finalized) that can be resumed.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

name: load_draft
description: BULK MODE: resume an unfinished draft (by number, name, or id) onto the workspace.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

card.description: The draft's number, name, or id.

name: read_world_lore
description: Pull the FULL text of any linked-world section or deep-dive entry (don't rely only on the summary; look up canon you need).

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

query.description: What canon/topic to look up in the linked world.

name: finalize_character
description: BULK MODE: save the finished NEW character to the output group AND advance to the next source card. The save happens immediately and synchronously. ⚠️ finalize_character MUST BE THE LAST TOOL CALL OF YOUR TURN — after it, STOP and end your turn. The result tells you the next source (already loaded); build it on your NEXT turn. Do NOT call list_output_cards or re-finalize in the same turn.

session.description: The builder session id you were given at the start of this build.

name: list_reference_cards
description: List the SOURCE characters currently loaded as reference material (a group or set the user picked in the References tab). These are READ-ONLY source cards to build NEW characters FROM — they are never modified or auto-saved. Returns each card id and name.

session.description: The builder session id. Pass it on every call.

name: read_reference_card
description: Read one loaded reference (source) character card in full, by name or id, so you can draw on it while helping build a new character. Read-only; never changes the working card. Call list_reference_cards first to see what is available.

session.description: The builder session id.

id.description: The reference card id or name to read.

name: edit_greeting
description: Replace the text of one alternate greeting by its 0-based index.

name: delete_greeting
description: Delete one alternate greeting by its 0-based index.

name: view_avatar
description: Get a link to the character's avatar image so you can LOOK at it: returns imageUrl - then call vision_analyze with image_url set to it and ask for what you need (species, build, skin, hair, eyes, face, marks, clothing, accessories, art style). Use it whenever the user refers to the avatar/picture, or to build or check appearance details from it. Pass reference to view a loaded reference card's avatar instead.

session.description: The builder session id.

reference.description: Optional: a loaded reference card's name or id - omit to view THIS character's avatar.
